name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands placed near waist level and fingers turned slightly outward to protect your wrists.
Shift your shoulders forward well ahead of your hands while squeezing your glutes and hollowing your core.
Maintain that forward lean as you bend your elbows closely along your sides to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press forcefully back up while keeping your shoulders shifted forward, finishing with strong scapular protraction at the top.
tips: Keep your shoulders forward throughout the entire press instead of drifting backward as you push up.
Adjust how far forward you lean to scale difficulty smoothly while keeping your body straight.
